verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a genuine llms.txt on the www origin, so an agent can be pointed at it. Its content is thin, though: it lists only the registered-agent, annual-report, and software marketing surfaces with one-line descriptions. The developer docs portal is a JS-rendered app shell that agents cannot easily read, and the only machine-readable developer surface is the public, keyless OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: llms.txt coverage of the developer and API docs, agent-readable (non-JS) developer documentation, an llms-full.txt or similarly in-depth agent-oriented guide, and independent corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: a genuine llms.txt on the www origin (the docs origin serves a JS app shell), listing the registered-agent, annual-report, and software surfaces with one-line descriptions.
